note: Every threshold this system uses. Frozen at kickoff (kickoff/PREREGISTRATION.md §3); changing one is an AMENDMENTS.md row. Hashed into every run header.

evidence.discovery_note: Roles that may be quoted but never counted toward min_sources. `none` is a mirror (a copy of another voice); `discovery` is a lead (a search hit whose page has not been fetched from its own publisher yet). Both are excluded by both policy mirrors.

budgets.tavily_credit_note: Tavily bills 1 credit per basic search and 2 per advanced; the discovery source searches every 120 minutes, so 30/day leaves headroom on the 1 000/month free tier.

review.note: how many refused-but-approvable deltas the loop keeps (with their patches) so an author ruling made later can still be acted on (D-32). Oldest first out; the drop is on the run log.
